notes.title: “Baptized for the dead”
notes.intro: Paul mentions people being baptised for the dead, a verse whose meaning is unclear.

views.label: A practice to be restored: proxy baptism for ancestors
views.summary: Latter-day Saints perform baptisms on behalf of the dead in temples, which those people may accept in the spirit world.

views.label: A practice Paul mentions but does not endorse
views.summary: Most Christians read it as a reference to an unknown practice in Corinth, which Paul uses to argue for the resurrection without approving it.
views.source: Common interpretation; St John Chrysostom, Homily 40 on 1 Corinthians
